name: Itchy Elephant 39
author: Cornerstone-04
description: Dark red text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: On focus, border becomes 2px solid #fa4753, text color changes to #fa4753, box-shadow becomes 4px 4px 10px #070707.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Itchy Elephant 39</title>
<style>
/* Itchy Elephant 39 by Cornerstone-04 — https://uiverse.io/Cornerstone-04/itchy-elephant-39 */
.input {
  max-width: 190px;
  height: 30px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  outline: none;
  border-bottom: 2px solid #3f3f3f;
  caret-color: #3f3f3f;
  background-color: #212121;
  padding: 5px;
  transition: .5s linear;
  font-family: monospace;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
}

.input:focus {
  border: 2px solid #fa4753;
  caret-color: #fa4753;
  color: #fa4753;
  box-shadow: 4px 4px 10px #070707;
}

.input:focus::placeholder {
  color: #fa4753;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input placeholder="Type here" class="input" name="text" type="text">

</body>
</html>
